title: Regret Lower Bound for Online Learning of Quantum States with Logarithmic Loss, with Applications to Quantum State Tomography and Confidence Sequences for Matrix Means
abstract: arXiv:2610.21273v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the problem of online learning of quantum states with logarithmic loss, which is a quantum generalization of online portfolio selection and has applications to quantum state tomography, the task of estimating an unknown quantum state from measurement outcomes. We first establish a regret lower bound, showing that the regret rates of Exponential Weights and the algorithm of Tseng et al. (2025) have optimal polynomial dependence on the dimension. Our analysis leads to two further results. First, our lower-bound proof leads to a quantum state tomography algorithm that is sample optimal up to polylogarithmic factors in the sample size. Second, we develop an algorithm for constructing confidence sequences for the mean of a matrix-valued random variable. A numerical experiment shows that the latter algorithm is competitive with existing methods.

translated_title: 基于对数损失的量子态在线学习的遗憾下界，及其在量子态层析成像与矩阵均值置信序列中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们研究基于对数损失的量子态在线学习问题，该问题是在线投资组合选择的量子推广，并应用于量子态层析成像，即从测量结果中估计未知量子态的任务。我们首先建立了一个遗憾下界，表明指数权重算法和Tseng等人（2025）提出的算法的遗憾率在维度上具有最优的多项式依赖性。我们的分析还带来了两个进一步的结果。首先，我们的下界证明导出了一种量子态层析成像算法，其样本复杂度在样本量方面达到最优（仅相差多对数因子）。其次，我们开发了一种用于构造矩阵值随机变量均值的置信序列的算法。数值实验表明，后一种算法与现有方法相比具有竞争力。
tldr: 本文建立了基于对数损失的量子态在线学习的最优遗憾下界，并由此导出样本量最优（至多相差多对数因子）的量子态层析成像算法，以及矩阵均值置信序列的构造算法。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes an optimal regret lower bound for online learning of quantum states with logarithmic loss, yielding a sample-optimal quantum state tomography algorithm (up to polylogarithmic factors) and a new algorithm for constructing confidence sequences for matrix means.
